name: relay
description: Main agent dispatches tasks to persistent Claude Code worker sessions via CLI; workers report back as compact, lossless-on-essentials relay packets.

claudeBin.title: Claude executable
claudeBin.description: Executable used to start worker sessions (no shell).

permissionMode.title: Worker permission mode
permissionMode.description: Permission mode passed to worker sessions.

workerModel.title: Worker model
workerModel.description: Default model for workers; empty uses the CLI default. Roles may override it.

workerEffort.title: Worker effort
workerEffort.description: Default effort for workers; roles may override it.

maxBudgetUsd.title: Budget per run (USD)
maxBudgetUsd.description: Upper cost limit for one worker run; 0 means no limit.

maxParallel.title: Parallel workers
maxParallel.description: How many workers run at once; further tasks wait in the queue.

runTimeoutMin.title: Timeout per run (minutes)
runTimeoutMin.description: A worker still running after this is stopped and reported as failed or partial; 0 means no timeout.

allowedTools.title: Allowed tools
allowedTools.description: Comma-separated tool rules workers may use without asking, e.g. Read, Grep, Bash(git status:*). Roles may override it.

disallowedTools.title: Disallowed tools
disallowedTools.description: Comma-separated tool rules workers may never use, e.g. Bash(git push:*), WebFetch. Roles may override it.

enforceOwns.title: Enforce ownership
enforceOwns.description: Block Edit, Write and NotebookEdit in a worker outside the paths its role owns (shell writes are not covered).

notifyMode.title: Packet delivery
notifyMode.description: prompt: wakes the main agent with a turn of its own. note: added silently, read at the next turn. toast: only a toast, packets via worker_status.

packetDetail.title: Packet detail
packetDetail.description: full: every field. lean: what needs action; facts, risks and next steps on demand.

fallbackCompress.title: Fallback compression
fallbackCompress.description: Build a packet with the fallback model when a worker forgot to emit one.

fallbackModel.title: Fallback compressor model
fallbackModel.description: Model that builds a relay packet when a worker forgot to emit one.

relayDir.title: Relay folder
relayDir.description: Project folder for run files (under runs/) and the default roles file.

rolesFile.title: Roles file
rolesFile.description: JSON file with predefined roles (brief, owns, model, effort, allowedTools, disallowedTools).

gitignore.title: Ignore run files in git
gitignore.description: Add <relay folder>/runs/ to .gitignore in git projects; the roles file stays versioned.

keepRuns.title: Runs kept per role
keepRuns.description: Run files rotate through this many slots per role; 0 keeps every run.
